name: Occupational Therapy
title: Occupational Therapy — BOT
intro: The occupational therapy route: eligibility, admission, course structure, internship and registration.

phases.title: Class 11–12 prerequisites
phases.summary: PCB with English is the usual requirement.
points: Choose PCB in Class 11–12.
Minimum marks are typically 50%.
Empathy, patience and communication skills matter.
Learn about occupational therapy in paediatrics, mental health and orthopaedics.

phases.title: Admission process
phases.summary: State counselling, NEET-UG, CUET-UG or merit.
points: Check your state’s route for allied health courses.
Apply through the counselling portal or university.
Choose a recognised college with a good clinical setup.
Complete document verification and fee payment.

phases.title: Four years of study
phases.summary: Anatomy, kinesiology, therapeutic activities and clinical OT.
points: Year 1: Anatomy, Physiology, Psychology and Sociology.
Year 2: Kinesiology, Therapeutic Activities, Pathology and Orthopaedics.
Year 3: Neurology, Paediatrics, Mental health and Community OT.
Year 4: Advanced clinical OT, Assistive technology, Research and supervised clinical postings.

phases.title: Clinical internship
phases.summary: Six months supervised work in hospitals and rehab centres.
points: Rotate through paediatric, neurological, orthopaedic and psychiatric OT.
Treat patients under supervision.
Prepare case reports and a logbook.
Complete the internship for degree award.

phases.title: Registration and career
points: Register with the state or national allied health body as required.
Jobs: hospitals, rehab centres, special schools and mental health centres.
Higher study: MOT in paediatrics, neurology, mental health or hand therapy.
Private practice and community-based rehabilitation work are also options.
